title: 彗·墨色远山
description: 长发画师彗穿完整蓝绿层衣，站在宽阔石台远望群山，巨笔笔尖朝下静持，硬边蜡笔光影构成修长轮廓。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Hwei is a slender adult Ionian male artist with very long dark hair, a pale contemplative face, and flowing painter's robes in muted blue-green tones. Preserve the broad signature brush and hanging pigment accessories while fully covering his torso with layered opaque garments and his legs with trousers and boots. The brush is held lowered and inactive, without threatening ink creatures or a spell gesture.
art_direction.scene: Frame him standing at the edge of a very broad safe stone terrace, one hand resting on the lowered brush handle and the other relaxed near the waist. Monumental mountain planes recede beyond a plain parapet. Strong cool side light and a narrow amber rim divide long cloth folds into expressive hard wax-crayon shapes, with ample clear atmospheric space.
art_direction.palette: ink blue, jade gray, charcoal hair, narrow amber light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
